items.name: utils
items.title: cn() utility
items.description: Minimal class-name joiner. Drop-in replacement for clsx in the small surface this library uses. JSX projects only.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A native <button> element with shadcn variants, sized for htmx v4. Ships in five flavours: Hono JSX (TypeScript), Jinja2 macro, Go html/template, Phoenix function component, and a raw HTML snippet. Follows the WAI-ARIA APG button pattern.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Native <input> with shadcn styling, sized for htmx live-validation patterns. Ships in five flavours.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Native <label> with shadcn polish — peer-disabled-aware, click-to-focus from the platform.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Native <input type="checkbox"> with shadcn polish — peer-checked SVG indicator, indeterminate support, htmx-ready.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Native <dialog> + 30-line script. Focus trap, ESC, accessible modal — all from the platform. Backdrop click to close, X button, htmx-rendered variants.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: WAI-ARIA tabs over real <button role="tab">. Inline boot script eliminates first-paint flicker; keyboard contract (arrows/Home/End) lives in site.js.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Native <textarea> with shadcn polish + CSS field-sizing: content auto-resize. htmx autosave demo.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Native input role="switch" styled as a sliding pill. Two sizes; htmx save-on-toggle pattern.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Native <input type="radio"> grouped by name; arrow-key cycle from the platform, custom dot indicator on top.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Native <select> + chevron icon overlay. Browser-driven dropdown, type-to-search, mobile-native picker. htmx cascading select demo.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Structural container — Header / Title / Description / Action / Content / Footer slots. Pure layout primitive; pair with htmx for content swaps.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small visual marker — status pill / counter / label. Six variants; renders as span (default) or anchor (with href).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider. Decorative (visual only) or semantic (renders <hr> or role="separator").

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Boxed informational / success / warning / error message. Five variants + live-region politeness (off / polite / assertive).

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient notifications. Fixed-position viewport + per-toast item with live-region politeness. Server-driven via htmx beforeend swap.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short label on a control. CSS-only show on hover + focus; ESC to dismiss. APG-compliant tooltip pattern.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible stacked sections. Native <details>/<summary> + new HTML name attribute for zero-JS exclusive accordion. APG keyboard nav in site.js.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round image with text/icon fallback. Native + inline onerror handler reveals fallback on 404. Group + count subcomponents.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Native HTML Popover API. Light dismiss + ESC + top-layer + focus restoration handled by the browser.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu of actions from a button. Native Popover API + APG menu keyboard contract (arrows, Home/End, type-to-find).

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: ARIA role="progressbar" with valuemin/max/now. Omit value for indeterminate (animated stripe). htmx polling demo for live updates.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Pulsing placeholder for content that hasn't loaded yet. role="status" + aria-busy; pairs with htmx outerHTML swap.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Native <input type="range"> styled cross-browser. role=slider + ARIA value attrs + arrow/Home/End/PageUp-Down keyboard contract come from the platform.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation strip. <nav> landmark + aria-label + aria-current="page" on the active link. Previous/Next have built-in aria-labels.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic <table>/<thead>/<tbody>; sortable columns via aria-sort + clickable button inside <th>. Sort actions route through htmx.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Autocomplete text input. Native <datalist> variant (zero JS) + APG role=combobox + htmx-filtered listbox variant.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: The native <meter> element (ARIA role="meter") — a gauge of a value within a known range with low/high/optimum zoning. Cross-browser fill colors via the meter pseudo-elements; includes an htmx live-gauge demo.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Native <input type="number"> styled like Input, with optional −/+ stepper buttons that call stepUp()/stepDown(). role=spinbutton, aria-valuenow/min/max, arrow-key stepping and value clamping all come from the platform. Ships in five flavours.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A native <nav> landmark wrapping an <ol> of links that shows the path to the current page; the current page is a plain <span aria-current="page">, separators are aria-hidden. Zero JS. Ships in five flavours and follows the WAI-ARIA APG breadcrumb pattern.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A native <a href> with shadcn styling — default (underlined), muted, and hover-underline variants, plus an external treatment that opens a new tab, sets rel="noopener noreferrer", and announces "(opens in new tab)".

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single show/hide disclosure built on native <details>/<summary> — click, Space, or Enter toggle and the browser mirrors aria-expanded, all with zero JavaScript. A standalone disclosure, distinct from the grouped Accordion.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts the user to confirm a consequential action. Native HTML <dialog> opened with showModal() and role="alertdialog"; not light-dismissible — the user must choose Cancel or the confirming action.

items.name: range-slider
items.title: Range Slider
items.description: A two-thumb range slider built from two overlaid native <input type="range"> on one track, each form-submittable (name=min/max), with the platform-provided role=slider and arrow/Home/End/PageUp/Down keyboard contract.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A role="toolbar" container that groups related controls (buttons, toggle buttons, separators) into a single tab stop with APG roving-tabindex arrow-key navigation. Ships ToolbarButton, ToolbarToggle, ToolbarSeparator, and ToolbarGroup subcomponents.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: A scrollable single- or multi-select list built on role="listbox" with role="option" children, following the WAI-ARIA APG keyboard contract. A hidden input mirrors the selection so it submits like a normal form field.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A visually-persistent, app-style horizontal bar of menus built on the native Popover API and the WAI-ARIA menu/menubar keyboard contract (roving tabindex, arrow navigation, type-ahead, ESC).

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A hierarchical role="tree" widget built from nested <ul>/<li> lists, where parent nodes carry aria-expanded and contain a nested role="group". Ships Tree, TreeItem, and TreeGroup subcomponents with the full WAI-ARIA APG keyboard contract and roving tabindex wired in site.js.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A slideshow built on native CSS scroll-snap (snap-x mandatory; each slide snap-center). WAI-ARIA carousel/slide roles, real <button> prev/next that scroll by one slide; touch, trackpad and keyboard scrolling are the platform's.

items.name: feed
items.title: Feed
items.description: A role="feed" container of <article> items that loads more as the user scrolls (htmx infinite scroll via hx-trigger="revealed"), following the WAI-ARIA APG Feed pattern. A structure, not a widget — screen readers stay in reading mode.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: An interactive data grid built on a real <table role="grid">: a single tab stop with 2-D arrow-key cell navigation (roving tabindex), Home/End to row ends, and Ctrl+Home/End to the grid corners.

items.name: treegrid
items.title: Treegrid
items.description: A hierarchical data grid: role="treegrid" rows expand and collapse like a tree (aria-expanded + aria-level) while cells navigate like a grid with the arrow keys. Built on a native HTML table, following the WAI-ARIA APG Treegrid pattern.

items.name: splitter
items.title: Splitter
items.description: A resizable two-pane split whose divider is a focusable role="separator" widget — drag it or use the arrow keys — driving a single CSS variable (--split) that sizes a grid track.

items.name: landmarks
items.title: Landmarks
items.description: An accessible page-shell from the native HTML landmark elements (header, nav, search, main, aside, section, footer). Thin semantic wrappers that expose the matching ARIA landmark role, with aria-label/aria-labelledby where the APG Landmarks practice requires a unique name. Zero JS.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: Field-row wrapper composing label + control slot + description + error, auto-wiring aria-describedby and aria-invalid, with a native :user-invalid styling hook. Includes a fieldset/legend group variant. Ships in five flavours; zero JS.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Styled label-wrapped native <input type="file"> with drag-and-drop, a filename/preview list, and a native <progress> bar. Submits via standard multipart POST. Ships in five flavours.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A native <button> that writes an associated string (snippet, API key, URL) to the clipboard with the Async Clipboard API, then flips to a transient aria-live "Copied" state. Progressive-enhancement fallback for non-secure contexts. Ships in five flavours: Hono JSX (TypeScript), Jinja2 macro, Go html/template, Phoenix function component, and a raw HTML snippet. Follows the WAI-ARIA APG button pattern.

items.name: date-time-picker
items.title: Date Time Picker
items.description: Native <input type="date|time|datetime-local|month|week"> family styled like Input, with min/max/step constraints and normalized machine-readable values. The browser supplies the calendar/clock picker, segment editing, locale-aware display and constraint validation — no JS calendar library. Ships in five flavours.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Edge-anchored slide-in drawer (left/right/top/bottom) built on the native <dialog> + showModal(): focus trap, ESC, ::backdrop and aria-modal from the platform. Light dismiss via the native closedby="any" attribute. Reuses Dialog's trigger/close wiring — zero new JS — and can stream its body in via htmx.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A rich interactive preview surface revealed when the user shows interest in a trigger (hover, keyboard focus, or long-press) — the interactive-content primitive Tooltip explicitly defers to. Built entirely on the native Popover API interest-invoker mechanism: the trigger carries interestfor and the card is popover="hint", so the browser owns hover/focus reveal, ESC dismissal, and implicit-anchor positioning with zero JavaScript. Progressive enhancement: in browsers without interest invokers the trigger stays a working link/button and the card (falling back to popover="manual") simply doesn't appear.

items.name: active-search
items.title: Active Search
items.description: A debounced live-search box (native <form role="search"> + <input type="search">) that filters an external results list/table as you type, with an inline loading indicator and stale-request cancellation. Submits as a normal GET search on Enter with zero JS.

items.name: edit-in-place
items.title: Edit In Place
items.description: A read-only record view with an Edit affordance that swaps in a pre-filled form. Save issues a PUT and the server returns the updated view; Cancel re-fetches the view. The canonical htmx editable primitive — built entirely on outerHTML swaps over REST, no modal, no custom JS.

items.name: load-more
items.title: Load More
items.description: A self-replacing pagination trigger. Click a button or scroll a sentinel into view; htmx appends the next page and swaps in a fresh trigger via hx-swap="outerHTML". When the server omits the trigger, the chain ends. The click mode is a real <button> so it works without JavaScript.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: A "Skip to main content" link: the first focusable element on the page, visually hidden until a keyboard user tabs to it, that jumps focus past the repeated banner/nav to the main landmark. A native <a href="#main"> with a CSS focus reveal — zero JavaScript. Ships in five flavours: Hono JSX (TypeScript), Jinja2 macro, Go html/template, Phoenix function component, and a raw HTML snippet. Built on the WAI-ARIA APG Landmark Regions practice.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Light / dark / system colour-scheme switcher. Honours prefers-color-scheme by default and persists an explicit override in a cookie so the server re-renders the right theme with no flash. Rendered as a native radiogroup of three radios (system / light / dark). Ships in five flavours: Hono JSX (TypeScript), Jinja2 macro, Go html/template, Phoenix function component, and a self-contained HTML snippet. Built on the prefers-color-scheme media feature + color-scheme property + cookie persistence; follows the WAI-ARIA APG radio group pattern.
